name: Awesome Generative AI Apps
summary: Curated list of 50+ open-source generative AI apps you can clone, deploy and monetize.
description: A directory of 50+ open-source generative AI SaaS templates — image and video generation, virtual try-ons, product photography, portraits, writing and chatbots — each wired with Stripe billing, Google OAuth and one-click Vercel deploy, grouped by use case with the paid tools they replace.
contains: 50+ AI apps in 10 sections: platforms, image, video, fashion, e-commerce, real estate, portrait, writing, agents, audio
each template: Stripe billing, Google OAuth, one-click Vercel deploy
credit billing model with a worked ~95% margin example
MIT licensed: clone, white-label and sell, no revenue share
every entry names the paid tool it competes with and its star count
